readingText.content:
Sports Day!

Yes, it’s that time of the year again! At Green Hills Secondary School, we always celebrate Sports Day before school finishes and we go on holiday. There are games and sports competitions for everyone. Here are some of the activities for this year:

100 metres running race

Are you good at running? Then this is the event for you!

400 metres relay race

As you know, this is a race for teams. There are four runners in each team. Each runner runs 100 metres of the race. Work together with your friends to get to the finish line!

Football race

In this event, you don’t run with a football. You kick a football along the race track. But be careful. The ball can’t go off the track!

Throwing

Yes, you can throw things in this event – but not your books! You can throw balls of all types and sizes – from tennis balls to volleyball balls. How far can you throw them?

Jumping

How far can you jump? And how high? Take part in this event, and see what your record is!

There are lots more games and activities on this special day. Check our school blog for more information, and get ready to have lots of fun!
